sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers it, and any later use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given cannot be given again by the one who no longer has it.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits an infinite self-referential value while only the demanded prefix is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: Endlessness is survivable when the present asks for only one piece of it.
sketches.draft:
breath :: [()]
breath = () : breath

now :: [()]
now = take 1 breath

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a closed channel succeeds immediately forever, yielding the zero value.
sketches.resonance: After closure, something empty can still arrive without blocking anyone.
sketches.draft:
package main

func main() {
    ch := make(chan struct{})
    close(ch)
    <-ch
    <-ch
}
